style: clean, modern, minimal nonprofit brand — calm confident motion, no ornate flicker or heavy texture; generous whitespace, single accent color doing the work

customize.catalog_check: npx hyperframes catalog --query "logo outro brand reveal with tagline and url" --json confirmed logo-outro (block, 1920x1080) live: 'Cinematic logo reveal with piece-by-piece assembly, glow bloom, tagline fade-in, and URL pill' — matches the brief's own beats almost verbatim.
customize.logo_redesign_v3: Logo redesigned AGAIN — user rejected v2's arch/gateway silhouette outright ('change that logo man i dont like that logo design something else man'). New concept has NO architectural/temple imagery: a protective ring with a leaf/flame droplet of life growing inside it. Geometry (48x48 grid): ring is a single continuous path `M24,8 A16,16 0 0 1 24,40 A16,16 0 0 1 24,8` (two semicircular arcs forming a full circle — written this way, not as a `<circle>`, specifically so `getTotalLength()`/stroke-dashoffset draw-on works reliably), stroked #18181B, stroke-width 3, round caps, fill none. The leaf/droplet is unchanged in spirit from v2 (kept because it read well): `M24,14 Q32,24 24,32 Q16,24 24,14 Z`, flat solid fill #A05708. There is NO separate baseline path this time — it's one ring path + one leaf path, only two shapes total. Recompute the ring's stroke length live via getTotalLength(); do not reuse any old path-length assumptions from v1/v2.
customize.mark_reveal_override: The ring draws on in one continuous stroke-dashoffset animation (rules/svg-path-draw) — no staggered second piece needed since there's no separate baseline anymore. Stroke color #18181B, fill:none until drawn, single draw motion feels like a pen completing a full circle.
customize.flame_ignition: Leaf/droplet path (flat fill #A05708) is not stroke-drawable — ignite it with scale_grow (0.7→1) + opacity fade-in as the ring's draw-on nears completion (slight overlap, not a hard cut), then logo-outro's own glow-bloom primitive fires on the ring/leaf group (soft amber glow, single pulse, no repeat/flicker) as the pattern-interrupt beat.
customize.wordmark_handwriting: MAJOR CHANGE — user explicitly asked that 'AetherVeda' be WRITTEN, like someone is writing it in signature style, not just faded in as static text. Reuse the registry block `hw-path-text` (installed and inspected: /Users/ramrac/Downloads/Rams/aetherveda-foundation/videos/aetherveda-intro (that copy was removed after inspection, but re-add it with `npx hyperframes add hw-path-text` to see its reference implementation again if needed) — it does a genuine per-character reveal along an SVG <textPath>, using per-tspan opacity stagger, which is exactly a convincing 'pen writing' effect, NOT a plain fade. Adapt its technique (SVG <path> geometry + <text><textPath>...<tspan> per character + GSAP opacity stagger on the tspans) directly into our lockup: 'The ' and ' Foundation' stay as plain HTML text in Hind (fade-in, as before) flanking an inline SVG that draws 'AetherVeda' along a NEARLY-FLAT, gently-curved path (NOT the demo's big wavy signature curve — ours needs to sit inline within a single text line at the same baseline height as 'The'/'Foundation') in the SAME 'Dancing Script' font already used on the actual website for this exact word (do NOT use the block's default Caveat font — brand consistency with the site matters here), color var(--accent) #A05708, weight 700, sized to match the site's treatment (roughly 1.2x the surrounding wordmark's em-size, per the site's own `.font-signature { font-size: 1.2em }` convention in components/HomeHero.tsx). Disable or heavily mute the block's dotted 'guide' path (its default rgba guide line) — we don't want a stray dashed line competing with our own separate underline-sweep beat; if kept at all, opacity should be near-zero.
customize.tagline_reveal: logo-outro's native tagline fade-in, Hind, muted ink or #A05708 accent weight, starting shortly after the full wordmark line (including the handwritten word) has landed.
customize.underline_sweep: accent-graphic underline_sweep (fromTo scaleX 0→1, transform-origin left center, power2.out, ~0.4s) under the wordmark+tagline block in #A05708, landing at beat 3 (3.75s), then hold to duration_s.
customize.url_pill: omitted — dropped logo-outro's URL pill for the clean minimal nonprofit look the brief asks for (no chip/badge clutter); aetherveda.org is not rendered as an on-screen element.
customize.background: pure white (#FFFFFF) full-bleed, no dark backdrop, no vignette/texture/flicker from logo-outro's default cinematic treatment.
customize.font: Hind for 'The'/'Foundation'/tagline; Dancing Script (700) specifically for the handwritten 'AetherVeda' — matches the site exactly, this is the one deliberate exception to 'sans-only'.

timing_beats_s.duration_note: Total duration extended from 4.0s to 5.0s to give the handwriting reveal room to read clearly — do not cram the typing into the old 0.5s wordmark window.
timing_beats_s.leaf_ignite: 0.65–1.00 (scale_grow + fade, power2.out, slight overlap with ring's tail)
timing_beats_s.aethervada_handwriting: 1.85–2.65 (per-character reveal along path, ~0.06–0.07s/char stagger for 10 characters, ease 'none' per the hw-path-text technique)
timing_beats_s.foundation_fade: 2.65–2.95 (fade_in, power1.out — the word 'Foundation', right after the handwriting finishes)
timing_beats_s.tagline_fade: 2.85–3.25 (beat @2.65s landing zone, fade_in, power1.out, slight overlap with 'Foundation')

brief: The AetherVeda Foundation mark (v3 redesign: a protective ring with a leaf/flame droplet of life inside it — no arch/gateway imagery, that was rejected) draws itself on as one continuous ring stroke, settles with a soft amber glow bloom as the leaf ignites, then 'The ' fades in, 'AetherVeda' is WRITTEN stroke-by-stroke in a handwritten signature style (Dancing Script, matching the site) as if someone is signing it live, ' Foundation' fades in, then the tagline. A thin amber underline sweep ties the lockup together before a brief hold. No flicker, no dark backdrop, no serif type outside the signature word, no URL pill, no gradient fill, no static/faded wordmark — the brand name has to visibly be written, not just appear.
